claims.quote: S. elongata is native to the upper Xe Nam Noi and Xe Pian rivers on the Bolovens plateau, southern Laos.
Both these flow off the plateau into the Se Kong river and it's also been recorded from the upper part of that drainage in Thua Thien-Hue province, central Vietnam.
